findings.label: Double-clear in EDIT path
findings.description: route.ts calls clearDraft(userId) on line 150 immediately before clearAll(userId) on line 151. clearAll already calls clearDraft internally, making the first call a redundant no-op. Remove the standalone clearDraft call and keep only clearAll.

findings.label: No CONFIRMED-state guard in route handler
findings.description: After CONFIRM succeeds, setSession marks the session CONFIRMED but the draft is never cleared. Neither Branch A nor Branch B handles the CONFIRMED status, so the next message from the same manager falls into Branch C (COLLECTING), loads the confirmed draft, and silently re-runs Gemini extraction against it. Add a branch that returns a 'transaction already confirmed — use /reset to start a new one' response when session.status === 'CONFIRMED'.

findings.label: Silent omission of client_name in income confirmation
findings.description: buildConfirmationTransaction uses a falsy `if (draft.client_name)` guard for the income-type client_name field instead of an explicit null/undefined/empty check that throws ConfirmationBuildError. This is inconsistent with the base-field guards (type, original_amount, original_currency, txn_date) that all throw explicitly. An income confirmation can silently reach Phase 6 without a client name. Either throw ConfirmationBuildError when client_name is missing for income, or document why silent omission is acceptable.
